_comment: Optional: copy to <project>/.claude/crypto-band.json. Every key has a default, so a partial file is fine.
_fixedCoins_comment: CoinGecko coin ids (never a ticker like BTC - see https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/coins/list for the full id list) that always stay on the board, whatever is trending. `symbol` is optional and overrides what the table shows in the 幣種 column; left out, it uses CoinGecko's own symbol for that id (already BTC/ETH/SOL/HYPE for the four below).
_trendingEnabled_comment: true (default) fills the rest of the table with CoinGecko's currently-trending coins, on top of fixedCoins. false shows fixedCoins only.
_trendingLimit_comment: How many trending coins to keep, out of the up-to-15 CoinGecko's search/trending answers (after de-duping against fixedCoins and excludedCoins). Clamped to 1-15.
_trendingRefreshMs_comment: How often the trending list itself is refreshed, in ms. Clamped to 60000 minimum. Unrelated to feedMs below - prices still poll on their own, much shorter interval.
_excludedCoins_comment: Tickers (not CoinGecko ids) that never count as trending, matched case-insensitively against the ticker CoinGecko reports - stablecoins by default, since their price barely moves.
_sort_comment: "change24h" (default) ranks by 24h%, "change1h" by 1h%, "volume" by 24h成交量, "list" leaves fixedCoins-then-trending order alone. The 排序 button cycles through all four at runtime; this just picks the starting one.
_feedMs_comment: Milliseconds between CoinGecko coins/markets requests. Clamped to 30000 minimum no matter what this says - crypto-band-mod never polls a public API faster than once every 30s.
_pageMs_comment: How long one page holds before 翻頁 auto-advances, in ms. 0 turns auto-paging off (the 翻頁 button still works by hand). The board is single-column (5 coins a page) so a full fixedCoins+trending watchlist auto-pages.
_refreshMs_comment: How often this module re-reads this file and re-renders. Has nothing to do with how often CoinGecko is polled - see feedMs/trendingRefreshMs.
_animation_comment: "full" (default) flaps rows on a value change and steps the live dot; "off" leaves the board still and only repaints once a second for the countdown.
